description:
Owner-only decision gate. Three BenchBox consumers read the soundness matcher as a file at a git ref with no package install: .github/workflows/ci.yml (git show $EVENT_BASE_SHA:_project/scripts/soundness_paths.py, two places), scripts/heavy_tier_needed.py (PREDICATE_REPO_PATH, runs base and PR copies with -I -S, fails closed to heavy_needed), scripts/changelog_fragments.py (_load_rules), plus coverage selection run with bare python.

Proposed: Theseus owns one stdlib-only matcher module; BenchBox keeps a single verbatim, hash-pinned copy recorded in the lock and updated only by promotion PRs, with a CI drift check against the pinned release.

Rejected alternatives (record if owner overrides): a wheel-extraction CI stage in each consumer (adds a network dependency to core CI units); a BenchBox-owned matcher plus a second Theseus parser (repeats the ship-no-ship gate-parity drift).

Options: (a) approve vendored copy; (b) wheel-extraction stage; (c) another arrangement the owner names.

Guardrails: agents must not choose.
